newsitem.title: USA: Monarch Casino sees record Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Monarch Casino sees record Q2 earnings.

text.p: Monarch Casino & Resort Inc said Wednesday it expects to post record second quarter earnings of between $0.13 and $0.15 a share.

Chief Executive John Farahi told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that the second quarter, ending June 30, will be the most profitable quarter in the company's history. Monarch earned $0.06 a share in the comparable year-ago quarter.
Increased customers from tourism and conventions boosted revenues at the company's Atlantis Casino Resort. Increased premium player business also helped results.

The company said that its strong results so far this year increases the likelihood that the expansion of the Atlantis will start during the current fiscal year. The City of Reno has approved plans to expand the hotel casino by adding about 25,000 square feet of casino space and up to 921 additional rooms.
